column1: # Frozen Real Time-Domain Protein Benchmark Manifest (docs/specs/11-fid-processing.md §5.2)
# Disjoint from all 21 empirical-prior entries (data/priors/PROVENANCE.md) and 12 Phase-1 entries (data/benchmark/manifest.tsv).
# Governance: `heldout` is evaluated strictly cold (at most once per phase, reported as-is); zero code, default, or threshold tuning may use `heldout` results.
# Phase 8 -> Phase 9 update (external review Q4): `5329` and `6318` were promoted from `heldout` to `dev`, and `16099` + `18489` were added to `heldout`.
# Phase 9 -> Phase 10 update (external review Q4 / P1-3): `15476`, `16385`, and `53280` were promoted from `heldout` to `dev` (10 `dev` entries),
# `5845,17030,18145,51351,16099,18489` are tagged `cohort=seen_p8_p9`, and 3 fresh pre-screened disjoint monomeric cold entries (`16072`, `16782`, `17092`)
# Phase 11 -> Phase 12 update (external review Q1): `16072`, `16782`, and `17092` (`cold_p10`) were promoted to `split=dev` (`cohort=dev_from_p10`, 13 `dev` entries total),
# and fresh pre-screened disjoint monomeric cold entries are added under `split=heldout`, `cohort=cold_p12` with pre-registered manifest SHA-256 in `data/benchmark/PROVENANCE.md`.

# Phase 12 -> Phase 13 update (external review P1-7 / W1 F4 / W2 P1-2): `cold_p12` (`5691,6585,15491,16096,16376,18337,18561`) was evaluated once at `v0.8.0` (`cohort=seen_p12`), `cold_p13` (`6209,6340,7175,15603,15819,15822,17192`) was evaluated once in Phase 13 Wave 1 (`cohort=seen_p13`, non-cold from Wave 2 onward), and `cold_p13_w2` (`5844,15089,15167,16238,16298,16313,18662`, pre-registered after Phase 13 Wave 2 code freeze `4b8ae5b` at `57a2244`) was evaluated once in Phase 13 Wave 2 and is relabelled `cohort=seen_p13_w2` (`split=heldout`, spent/non-cold per `13.1:P1-2`; 13 `dev` + 27 `heldout` = 40 total).
